build_gmm_initialization_comparison: build a comparison of GMM initialization methods including kmeans, random, random_from_data, and k-means++
create_gmm_with_kmeans_init: create a GaussianMixture model with kmeans initialization and fit it to clustered blob data
test_gmm_predict_clusters: test the GaussianMixture predict method to assign cluster labels to generated sample data
summarize_gmm_init_times: summarize the relative initialization times and iteration counts for each GMM init method
run_gmm_with_precomputed_means: run a GaussianMixture with precomputed initial means and fit to data for up to 2000 iterations
